title: cvpw project.json
description: The only place project knobs live. See docs/CONTRACTS.md §2. Unknown top-level keys are rejected (docs/SPEC.md A4) so that a misspelled knob fails loudly instead of silently taking a default.

id.description: Stable identifier; used for output filenames. Lowercase, no spaces.

credit.description: The exact on-screen credit line. Ask the user; never invent it. Must appear verbatim in the end card and in README.md.

safe.description: Minimum inset from every edge for anything that must not be clipped. Defaults to 5.33% of height (96 px at 1080p).

subtitleBand.description: Content at or below this y is within the subtitle band. Defaults to 85.2% of height (920 px at 1080p).

file.description: Project-relative path. Never modified by a tool.

offset.description: Seconds of lead-in applied AT MUX TIME. Editing the source file to achieve this is forbidden (docs/SPEC.md P6).

mode.description: 'measured' requires analysis/audio.json before storyboard or render; 'manual' permits only cue and absolute-second times.

style.description: The default style for shots that do not name one. Must be registered; an unregistered name is an error, never a fallback, because a silent fallback would restyle a film without anyone noticing.

allowSoftware.description: Permit rendering under a software rasteriser. Off by default: it is ~10x slower and produces a different artefact.

textWhitelist.description: Every string that may appear on screen (docs/SPEC.md C6). An empty array is legal and means 'this film puts no text on screen', which is then enforced.

lyricsText.description: Required when cues/lyrics.json exists. 'local-only' makes `cvpw deliver` refuse to publish lyric text (docs/SPEC.md T7).

lyricsLicence.description: Required when lyricsText is 'licensed': who granted permission and for what.

global.description: The root of every seeded generator. Changing it restyles every noise-driven element at once, which is why it is a project knob.

extensions.description: Additive, non-breaking per-project data. Predicted extensions live here so that adding one never requires a schemaVersion bump (docs/SPEC.md A3).
